method: Natural-language task. Pi selected and invoked browser tools; Codex approved browser actions, selected a local test CSV and confirmed handoff. Backend state checked independently.
issues: One action and one page read were attempted without a fresh observation and rejected; model recovered.
Takeover resolved the selection; a subsequent verify_file call failed because no selection was pending. The model then relied on visible filename and size.
Fixture returned stale pending status on re-query despite a successful server submission; model explicitly reported the discrepancy in its final answer and did not repeat the submission.
limitations: One run, no reliability or speed estimate
Local fixture, not real platform or anti-bot test
File selection and action confirmations performed by Codex
No independent content/path verification by the model
